comment: kiln.ui's game-UI integration on the client (enshrouded.exe 26404966). Evidence: docs/re/game-ui.md. The game's UI is immediate mode: GameUiSystem calls its update fn (GameUiFrame, registered at app start) once per UI frame on the UI thread; the frame context sits in the global UiApp only while that call runs. GameUiFrame's first argument is the GameUiSystem+0x10; its +sys.data is the persistent GameUiData (first field: the GameUi state, whose byte +state.ui_state is keen::UiState and +state.play the play data, whose byte +play.hud_screen is keen::HudScreenType and +play.interaction the entity the player interacts with). Menu entries are drawn by two entry renderers: MainMenuEntry(state, {text, len, fnv64, 8 option bytes}) in the main menu builder and SystemMenuEntry({text, len, fnv64}, 1, attention) in the system (pause) menu and a few other lists; both return true on activation and take part in the frame's focus/gamepad navigation. kiln.ui draws its entries through them right before the Settings entry (main menu: both layout branches, ShroudForge 1.7.6's insertion point; system menu: the Settings entry), identified by the call's return address. CraftingMenu is the crafting menu builder (every frame while one is open); its last selected recipe id is stored at data+data.craft_recipe (the player's own menu) or *(data+data.station_recipe) (a station). Main-menu page (feature ui.menu_page, docs/re/game-ui.md "Main-menu pages", client 26430625, static analysis): the PreGame state block (never cached: the UI's state store frees blocks not touched in a frame) keeps the current page at +pregame.page; PreGameGoTo(pregame, page) only compares and writes it. MainMenuEntry's first argument is pregame+pregame.main_menu at the Settings and Credits call sites. Kiln's MODS entry calls PreGameGoTo(pregame, pregame.page_credits); its hook on PreGameCredits (bool(void)) answers only the call from the PreGame page switch (return address PreGameCreditsRet): true stays, false makes the game go back to page_main_menu itself. The UI system's update writes the canvas (sys.canvas_w/h, UI units), the viewport (sys.viewport: x, y, w, h floats, pixels) and pixels per unit (sys.px_per_unit) at system offsets; GameUiFrame's first argument is system+sys.frame_arg. The error popup shows while the byte at frame_arg-relative sys.popups + popups.error is set. ui.menu_page_sound: UiPlaySound(*UiApp, &copy of cfg+cfg.sound_entry_cancel) as PlaySelection's back does. Main-menu footer (feature ui.menu_footer, docs/re/game-ui.md "The main menu's footer", client 26430625, static analysis): MainMenuFooter is the game's footer function (void(void), window "LegalLine": a bottom-aligned stack with the build number and the legal line), called only at the end of the main menu page. MainMenuFooterBuildLine is its call of NativeTextLine(out, GameText*, style, mode) for the build number; the text object built there sits at rbp+footer.text and the game sets its fields at rbp+footer.text_* (node pointer, a shown byte, two colours to alpha 0x7f, flags |= 0x48, flags2 = 0, a bits byte |= 1, the size from cfg+cfg.footer_font) before NativeTextDraw(object). kiln.ui runs a copy of MainMenuFooter whose build-number call goes through Kiln first: Kiln's line is drawn there the same way (XHL-Core 2.1.0 patches this very call for its "All mods loaded" line, which the copy leaves out). Factory screens (0.2.0-dev.29.15, docs/re/game-ui.md section 5): @ui/HudCrafting.fields is the HUD screen dispatcher's crafting cases (client 26430625: 0xbe87d0; StationBasedCrafting 25 and NpcCrafting 27). Both need play+play.target, the entity the screen is about (0: they close it), and read the station's workshop from play+0x2e48 (play.interaction) before they call CraftingMenu. FactoryCrafting 28 has no case there (PlayStateUi runs the chest-style transfer screen 0xb9d0f0 with mode 2 for it, which finds the station's inventory view by play+play.target), so kiln.ui reads play.target itself while a factory screen shows (screen_target).
